title: Faktor certification evidence object
description: Exact-SHA evidence written by a certification lane into target/certification/evidence/<kind>.json. Booleans never certify: only a schema-valid object bound to the commit and tree, with digests matching the recorded commands/artifacts, certifies. Release-grade gates additionally require an ed25519 signature by an allowlisted CI identity (scripts/certification/evidence.mjs verify --require-signed).

repository.description: Repository identity (git remote URL, or an explicit name when no remote is configured).

commit_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD at the moment the evidence was written.

tree_hash.description: git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' at the same moment: the tree object of the commit (the documented tree-hash command; do not use git write-tree, which would hash the mutable index).

kind.description: Evidence kind; must match the file name target/certification/evidence/<kind>.json.

commands_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical command-set text (commands joined with newlines, no trailing newline).

artifact_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical artifact list: for each artifact sorted by path, the line '<sha256>:<hex>\t<path>\n'; sha256 of the empty string when there are no artifacts.

repository_tree_verified.description: True when the writer confirmed tree_hash equals git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' at write time.

commands.description: Optional human-readable command list; the digest alone is normative.

public_key.description: Base64 raw 32-byte ed25519 public key; must match the allowlisted key for identity.

value.description: Base64 ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of this object without the signature field (keys sorted).
